Sandbach United vs Alsager Town

Admission:
👨 Adults – £6
🎟️ Concessions – £5
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Kids – £2

Back to Sandbach again this time in the NWCFL South. Come down to support the bullets in this local derby fixture! ✊ https://t.co/ODeHI1fM7G
Local derby day as The Bach take on Alsager as top takes on near the bottom, and we look to avenge last weeks cup defeat to them on pens. Let’s do this!!! https://t.co/ZZKa8hl0iP

🔵⚪️ v 🔴🔴
Sandbach United v Alsager Town

The Bach welcome Matty Birchall into the starting 11 and both Nathan Barry and Robbie Hatton returning to the starting line up after not being available for last weeks cup match, Jacob Vernon also comes back in at left back. Up the Bach

Alsager Town XI: 📋

Peake (GK), Latter, Denny, Watts, Cartwright, Parry, Cowley, Fitton (C), Hurst, Bush, Renshaw.

Substitutes: Minshall, Bentley, Geddes, Catalano, Brown. 🪑
